text:
maya: quick ping — main CI turned red right after the fast-merge at 1759932000. integration-smoke stage is stuck on "pulling images" for ~10m. https://ci.redwood/internal/builds/17599

devin: seeing same. job page: https://ci.redwood/job/17599/step/integration-smoke

sam: @ci-bot any error logs?

ci-bot: build 17599 step integration-smoke: ERROR: timeout while pulling image "redwood/runner:2026-03-17" — retrying (attempt 3/3)

ryan: @maya can you try rerun? quick rerun might land on different runner

maya: kicked a rerun -> https://ci.redwood/retry/17599 (started)

alice: I see a flurry of container pull failures across eu-west runners in monitoring

sam: thanks alice — could be registry throttling after our new nightly image push

devin: small idea — can someone try rerun with pinned older runner image? `/ci rerun --image=redwood/runner:2026-03-16`

maya: re-run started with pinned image

ci-bot: rerun 17599.2: job passed build step "integration-smoke" but then flaked on "kv-cache-integration.test: timeout"

ryan: that suggests test flake vs infra. @sam can you grab logs from the failed test run?

sam: logs:
```
kv-cache-integration.test: connecting to shard-3... ok
kv-cache-integration.test: load pattern step timed out at 120s
Traceback: grpc deadline exceeded
```

alice: I pushed a change to test harness timeout last night — rolling that back in a sec

devin: if roll back helps we can avoid bisect; but keep an eye on infra too

maya: thanks — I'm going to queue a bisect if we see another red after revert

sam: ack, will hold for revert result :thumbsup:
